essence: Devotees must worship and praise the deity diligently with diverse hymns.
Bathing in that place removes the sin of brahman-murder.
Five bows to the north of that place lies the site named Kapilā.
Bathing at Kapilāhnadatīrtha requires a restrained mind.
One must ascend Bhasmakūṭaka while facing east.
